CustomField.description: If the Account is tied to an IMGA, it will return that IMGA's Account Segment, otherwise it will return the Account Segment listed on the Account. #28092: If IMGA Account has Global Industries enabled, fetches IMGA's Account Segment else fetches Country Parent's Account segment
CustomField.formula:
/* The values in Segment are copied down to the all Child Accounts (Country Parent,Sales Site) when IMGA Account has 'Global Industries' checkbox marked True else data is copied from Country Parent to Sales Site*/
IF(AND( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Sales (Site)'), ISPICKVAL(Parent.Parent.IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'IM Group (IMGA)'), Parent.Parent.Global_Account__c ), TEXT(Parent.Parent.Account_Segment__c), IF(AND( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Sales (Site)'), ISPICKVAL(Parent.IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Country Parent') ),TEXT(Parent.Account_Segment__c), IF(AND( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Country Parent'), ISPICKVAL(Parent.IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'IM Group (IMGA)'), Parent.Global_Account__c ),TEXT(Parent.Account_Segment__c),TEXT(Account_Segment__c))))
CustomField.label: Account Segment
